sentences.en: Hello, and welcome back to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes and transitions of our 20s
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到《你二十多岁的心理学》，在这个播客里，我们探讨二十多岁时的一些重大生活改变和转折，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及它们对我们心理意味着什么。

sentences.en: Hello, welcome, new listeners, old listeners, first-timers, whoever you are.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎新听众、老听众、初次收听的听众，无论你是谁。

sentences.en: So excited to have you here on the podcast,
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来到这个播客节目，

sentences.en: talking about some very exciting, fun, relevant topics today.
sentences.zh: 今天我们来聊一些非常令人兴奋、有趣且切合实际的话题。

sentences.en: Something that I've really wanted to cover for a while and that feels particularly relevant because I obviously haven't posted for a hot minute, maybe like a couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 这个话题我其实想聊很久了，而且感觉特别应景，因为我显然有一段时间没发动态了，大概有几个星期吧。

sentences.en: For this very reason, I've been absolutely swamped with my actual job, my real job.
sentences.zh: 正是因为这个原因，我被我的实际工作、我的正职工作忙得不可开交。

sentences.en: Hence, the motivation, the inspiration to talk about hustle culture and burnout on this episode.
sentences.zh: 因此，这就是本期节目要聊聊内卷文化和职业倦怠的动力和灵感来源。

sentences.en: But before we get to that topic and to all the psychology behind it,
sentences.zh: 但在我们进入这个话题以及它背后的所有心理学之前，

sentences.en: I just want to update everyone about a new feature that this podcast has.
sentences.zh: 我只想向大家通报一下本播客的一项新功能。

sentences.en: So in, I don't know, the last few weeks, we have gained so many new listeners.
sentences.zh: 所以在过去的几周里，我不知道，我们收获了非常多的新听众。

sentences.en: So welcome to you all, if you've just started listening in.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你刚刚开始收听，欢迎你们所有人。

sentences.en: And I thought it would be a really amazing time to start publishing some more personal and paid content, mainly some of my guest episodes, my Let's Get Friendly segment,
sentences.zh: 我觉得现在是一个非常棒的时机，可以开始发布一些更具个人色彩和付费的内容，主要是我的嘉宾访谈节目，也就是我的“交个朋友”板块，

sentences.en: where I chat to some of my friends, other people I know in their 20s, just about their life experiences, the struggles and situations they're finding themselves in,
sentences.zh: 在这个板块里，我与一些朋友、其他我认识的二十多几岁的人聊天，专门聊聊他们的生活经历、他们发现自己正身处其中的挣扎和困境，

sentences.en: some of my Loveline episodes, where we answer love queries and questions and conundrums that you guys send in.
sentences.zh: 还有我的“情感热线”节目，我们在那里解答你们发来的恋爱疑问、问题和难题。

sentences.en: So a lot of that content now,
sentences.zh: 所以其中很多内容，

sentences.en: I'm hoping to put out once or twice a month.
sentences.zh: 我希望每个月能推出一到两次。

sentences.en: And I now have paid subscriptions, which is super exciting.
sentences.zh: 现在我推出了付费订阅功能，这真的超级令人兴奋。

sentences.en: So if you feel called to, you can sign up for that on Spotify, if that's where you're listening, on Apple Podcasts, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你有这种意愿，你可以在Spotify上注册，如果你是在那里收听的话，也可以在Apple Podcasts上，或者在你获取播客的任何平台上注册。

sentences.en: I'm super excited to be kind of moving into that new stage of the podcast and being able to offer some more interesting and niche
sentences.zh: 我非常兴奋能够进入播客的这个新阶段，能够为忠实听众提供更多有趣、小众

sentences.en: and personal content to those who are frequent listeners.
sentences.zh: 且极具个人色彩的内容。

sentences.en: So thank you for all the support so far.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家一直以来的支持。

sentences.en: And for those who have already subscribed in that capacity, obviously still putting out the regular episodes that you can listen to at your leisure.
sentences.zh: 对于那些已经通过这种方式订阅的朋友，我当然还是会继续推出常规节目，供大家在闲暇时收听。

sentences.en: But for people who are wanting to hear some more of that stuff, please feel free to subscribe.
sentences.zh: 但对于那些想听更多这类内容的人，请随时订阅。

sentences.en: And thank you for all of the support so far.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家一直以来的支持。

sentences.en: Anyhow, with that aside, this week we are talking about a highly requested topic that I get on Instagram all the time.
sentences.zh: 言归正传，抛开这些不谈，本周我们要讨论的是一个在Instagram上呼声极高的话题。

sentences.en: We are talking about hustle culture.
sentences.zh: 我们要聊聊内卷文化。

sentences.en: We're talking about burnout.
sentences.zh: 我们要聊聊职业倦怠。

sentences.en: The two often go hand in hand and have super important ties to psychology and surprise, surprise, our 20s.
sentences.zh: 这两者往往密不可分，并且与心理学有着超级紧密的联系，而且不出所料，这正切合我们二十多岁的年龄段。

sentences.en: So our main topic of the day is hustle culture.
sentences.zh: 所以我们今天的主题就是内卷文化。

sentences.en: This is a term that I think has come about pretty recently and I'm sure we've all encountered it in some capacity.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我认为出现没多久的词，而且我确信我们在某种程度上都接触过它。

sentences.en: Perhaps, I don't know, you've seen it talked about on TikTok or Instagram on your For You page, especially if you're in the corporate lifestyle or on that pathway.
sentences.zh: 也许，我不知道，你在TikTok或Instagram的“为你推荐”页面上看到过关于它的讨论，特别是如果你身处企业职场生活或正走在这条道路上。

sentences.en: You've heard about it amongst friends.
sentences.zh: 你在朋友之间也听说过它。

sentences.en: If you haven't heard about it, think phrases like rise and grind and people constantly talking about, almost bragging about their long hours and relentless schedule.
sentences.zh: 如果你没听说过，想想那些诸如“奋斗与磨砺”（rise and grind）的短语，人们总是在谈论、甚至近乎炫耀他们漫长的工作时间和永无止境的日程安排。

sentences.en: It is super common, I think, in our 20s and in the early stages of our careers
sentences.zh: 我认为这在我们的二十多岁以及职业生涯的早期阶段超级普遍，

sentences.en: to really be like striving and aiming for a work-life balance that is more centered on work and success and gaining money and status and promotions
sentences.zh: 我们总是真心实意地去拼搏和追求一种工作与生活的平衡，而这种平衡更多地以工作、成功、赚钱、获取地位和晋升

sentences.en: and all of those kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 以及所有诸如此类的事情为中心。

sentences.en: I think I am definitely at fault of buying into hustle culture and I'm trying to be more conscious of how this lifestyle and this image and almost this kind of philosophy
sentences.zh: 我觉得我绝对也犯了接受内卷文化的毛病，我正试图更有意识地去意识到这种生活方式、这种形象、甚至可以说是这种哲学理念

sentences.en: has become indoctrinated into my own mind and my working habits and patterns, hence this episode.
sentences.zh: 是如何渗透进我自己的思想以及工作习惯和模式中的，这也是本期节目的由来。

sentences.en: And we're also going to be talking about burnout.
sentences.zh: 同时我们也将探讨职业倦怠。

sentences.en: Burnout is kind of a separate thing, I think, in many ways, but there are heaps of links and I think that you don't need to be buying into hustle culture to be experiencing burnout
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，职业倦怠其实是一个相对独立的概念，但它们之间有着千丝万缕的联系，而且我认为你并不需要接受内卷文化才会经历职业倦怠，

sentences.en: and maybe you're someone who's working super hard in a crunch period at work, but you might not necessarily be burnt out.
sentences.zh: 也许你只是一个在工作中处于冲刺期而拼命工作的人，但你未必就一定精疲力竭了。

sentences.en: But I thought that they really did go hand in hand and complemented each other quite well for this episode.
sentences.zh: 但我认为它们确实紧密相连，对于这期节目来说，它们是很好的互补。

sentences.en: We're going to be talking about a bunch of things.
sentences.zh: 我们将讨论很多事情。

sentences.en: We're going to be talking about why hustle culture and, you know,
sentences.zh: 我们将讨论为什么内卷文化以及，你知道的，

sentences.en: the expansion of our working hours beyond the nine to five and, you know, passive income and trying to, you know, seek promotion and that work heavy lifestyle
sentences.zh: 我们超出朝九晚五的工作时间的延伸，以及被动收入，试图寻求晋升的那种重工作的生活方式

sentences.en: has become so much more, I don't want to say popular, but so much more common for people in their 20s.
sentences.zh: 变得越来越——我不想说受欢迎，而是变得对二十多岁的人来说越来越普遍。

sentences.en: And who benefits from that?
sentences.zh: 谁从这其中受益了呢？

sentences.en: What the impact of that has been on society and culture and on an individual level around our mental health?
sentences.zh: 它对社会、文化以及围绕我们心理健康的个人层面产生了什么影响？

sentences.en: And that's where burnout comes in.
sentences.zh: 这就是职业倦怠切入的地方。

sentences.en: That is a really interesting relationship to me and I'm going to be talking about what the impacts of, you know, long-term cortisol levels and long-term stress and long hours
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这是一种非常有趣的关联，我将探讨长期皮质醇水平、长期压力、长时间工作

sentences.en: and a lack of sleep does to our body and does to our minds and our well-being and why it's important to have aspirations beyond financial and career success in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 以及睡眠不足对我们的身体、心理和健康会造成什么影响，以及为什么在二十多岁时，拥有超越金钱和职业成功的抱负是如此重要。

sentences.en: It's so critical for our long-term development, especially in our formative years, to achieve a healthy work-life balance and to centre ourselves on what we really want
sentences.zh: 对于我们的长期发展来说，在我们的成型期实现健康的工作与生活平衡，并将我们的核心聚焦于我们未来真正想要的东西，是至关重要的，

sentences.en: in the future because this is where our patterns and our expectations for our life kind of start to take form and take shape.
sentences.zh: 因为正是从这里开始，我们对生活的模式和期望开始逐渐成形。

sentences.en: So super interesting, very relevant and hopefully you get something out of this if these kind of topics have been something that's been on your mind recently
sentences.zh: 所以这超级有趣，非常切实际，希望如果这些类型的话题最近一直萦绕在你的脑海中，你能从中有所收获，

sentences.en: as it has been on mine.
sentences.zh: 就像它们一直萦绕在我的脑海中一样。

sentences.en: Okay, so what's hustle culture?
sentences.zh: 好吧，那么什么是内卷文化？

sentences.en: What are we talking about today?
sentences.zh: 我们今天到底在谈论什么？

sentences.en: Essentially, hustle culture teaches us that there is always more, more money to make, a bigger title or a promotion, a higher wall to climb and it is a state
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，内卷文化教导我们，总有更多的东西要去追求——更多的金钱去赚取，更高的头衔或晋升，更高的高峰去攀登，它是一种

sentences.en: of kind of constant hustling as the name says or working with complete and utter commitment to your work maybe with no time out or breaks, skipping meals, rest time,
sentences.zh: 正如其名，不断内卷的状态，或者说对工作投入完全且绝对的承诺，可能没有休息时间或假期，不吃饭，没有休息时间，

sentences.en: maybe even sleep to continue working towards your professional goals.
sentences.zh: 甚至牺牲睡眠，以继续朝着你的职业目标努力。

sentences.en: It's really centred on our relationship with work and hustle culture has emerged recently I think in the past
sentences.zh: 它真正以我们与工作的关系为中心，而内卷文化最近才出现，我认为是在过去的

sentences.en: 30, 20 years even kind of as this new type of lifestyle in which work is at the centre and our personal priorities and our personal lives are kind of pushed to the side.
sentences.zh: 30年、甚至20年里，作为一种新型的生活方式出现，在这种生活方式中，工作处于核心地位，而我们的个人优先事项和个人生活则被推到了次要位置。

sentences.en: We could talk about capitalism, we could talk about all of those structures that we exist in but sadly this is a psychology podcast so we're going to be talking more about
sentences.zh: 我们可以谈论资本主义，我们可以谈论我们身处其中的所有那些结构，但遗憾的是这是一个心理学播客，所以我们要更多地谈论

sentences.en: the mental element to this kind of recent phenomenon and we're also going to take a moment to reflect on hustle culture and what it is that we're after and how we can
sentences.zh: 这种近期现象背后的心理因素，我们也将花点时间反思内卷文化，反思我们究竟在追求什么，以及我们如何在

sentences.en: consciously take care of ourselves whilst we reach and carve out our ambitions.
sentences.zh: 实现和开辟雄心壮志的同时，有意识地照顾好自己。

sentences.en: How is it that we can recenter our aspirations and our goals and what we actually want whether that's in our professional or personal lives whilst also maintaining balance
sentences.zh: 我们该如何重新以我们的抱负、目标以及我们真正想要的东西为中心——无论是在职业生活中还是个人生活中——同时保持平衡

sentences.en: and incorporating other important elements that are crucial for our well-being.
sentences.zh: 并融入对我们健康至关其他的重要元素。

sentences.en: So I think hustle culture glorifies overworking as sort of a badge of honour.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为内卷文化将过度工作美化为一种荣誉的象征。

sentences.en: It often sets up an environment of fear, guilt and shame especially when you don't feel like perhaps you're running at the same pace as everyone around you.
sentences.zh: 它经常营造出一种充满恐惧、内疚和羞耻的环境，尤其是当你觉得自己奔跑的速度似乎赶不上周围的其他人时。

sentences.en: Hustle culture this phenomenon of working harder and working more is a social structure it's a social phenomenon that only has power because other people buy into it
sentences.zh: 内卷文化——这种工作更努力、工作更多的现象，是一个社会结构，它是一个社会现象，之所以有力量，仅仅是因为其他人也买账了，

sentences.en: and as a collective we start to see a trend in the way that we work now and in a way that we've been socialised to feel about work which is that it's become a lot more important
sentences.zh: 作为一个集体，我们开始看到我们现在的工作方式以及我们被社会化对待工作的方式出现了一种趋势，那就是工作变得重要得多，

sentences.en: and that we should be prioritising our professional ambitions perhaps over our more personal ambitions.
sentences.zh: 并且我们应该把我们的职业抱负放在首位，也许要凌驾于我们的个人抱负之上。

sentences.en: So hustle culture as a cultural and social phenomenon is really interesting.
sentences.zh: 所以，作为一种文化和社会现象的内卷文化真的非常有趣。

sentences.en: I think it's become normal because ambition has become disguised as a lifestyle rather than as a means to an end and millennials I guess young people in particular perhaps
sentences.zh: 我认为它已经变得正常化，因为野心已经被伪装成了一种生活方式，而不再是达到目的的手段，千禧一代——我想尤其是年轻人，

sentences.en: if you're a recent graduate you're particularly likely to fall into this kind of like workaholism that hustle culture perpetuates you know the 70-80 hour work week and that kind
sentences.zh: 如果你刚毕业，你特别容易陷入这种内卷文化所长期延续的工作狂状态，你知道的，每周工作70-80小时，这种

sentences.en: of hustle mania has become something that has been drilled into us as society kind of breathes into this idea that work is more important than the other things that make
sentences.zh: 内卷狂热已经深深植入我们的脑海，因为社会开始灌输这样一种理念：工作比其他让生活变得重要的事情更重要。

sentences.en: life important.
sentences.zh: 生活中的重要事物。
